# WAS_mme_FastBMA { #wass2s.WAS_mme_FastBMA }

```python
WAS_mme_FastBMA(model_type='normal', tol=0.001)
```

Grid-based Bayesian Model Averaging — SLSQP maximum-likelihood fitting.

## Supported ``model_type`` values {.doc-section .doc-section-supported-modeltype-values}

``'normal'``
    Gaussian BMA (Raftery et al. 2005).  Component: N(f_k, σ²) where f_k
    is the k-th raw ensemble member and σ is a single shared standard
    deviation fitted by maximum likelihood.

``'gamma'``
    Gamma mixture for strictly positive quantities (wind speed, etc.).
    Parameterisation: Γ(shape, scale = f_k / shape) so that
    E[Y | k] = f_k.  A single shared shape parameter is estimated.

``'gamma0'``
    Zero-adjusted Gamma mixture for precipitation
    (Sloughter et al. 2007, §2).  The marginal model is

        P(Y = 0)  = 1 − POP
        P(Y > 0)  = POP · Γ-mixture(shape, f_k / shape)

    where POP is estimated via logistic regression on three predictors:
    intercept, ∛ens_mean, and fraction of wet ensemble members
    (Sloughter et al. 2007 Eq. 1).

## Tercile thresholds {.doc-section .doc-section-tercile-thresholds}

Provide either ``clim_terciles`` (dims: ``('tercile', Y, X)``) or
``obs_for_terciles`` (dims include ``time_dim, Y, X``); terciles are then
computed per gridpoint.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [compute_gridpoint_terciles_from_obs](#wass2s.WAS_mme_FastBMA.compute_gridpoint_terciles_from_obs) | Compute per-gridpoint tercile thresholds from a climatological sample. |
| [fit](#wass2s.WAS_mme_FastBMA.fit) | Fit BMA parameters at every gridpoint via SLSQP maximum-likelihood. |
| [predict_probabilistic](#wass2s.WAS_mme_FastBMA.predict_probabilistic) | Generate probabilistic forecasts from the fitted BMA mixture. |

### compute_gridpoint_terciles_from_obs { #wass2s.WAS_mme_FastBMA.compute_gridpoint_terciles_from_obs }

```python
WAS_mme_FastBMA.compute_gridpoint_terciles_from_obs(
    obs,
    *,
    time_dim='T',
    lat_dim='Y',
    lon_dim='X',
    q=(1 / 3, 2 / 3),
)
```

Compute per-gridpoint tercile thresholds from a climatological sample.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                            |
|--------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | xr.DataArray | dims: ``('tercile', lat_dim, lon_dim)``; tercile ∈ ['lower', 'upper']. |

### fit { #wass2s.WAS_mme_FastBMA.fit }

```python
WAS_mme_FastBMA.fit(
    hcst_grid,
    obs_grid,
    *,
    member_dim='M',
    time_dim='T',
    lat_dim='Y',
    lon_dim='X',
    min_samples=10,
)
```

Fit BMA parameters at every gridpoint via SLSQP maximum-likelihood.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                         | Description   | Default    |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------|---------------|------------|
| hcst_grid | dims(member_dim, time_dim, lat_dim, lon_dim) |               | _required_ |
| obs_grid  | xr.DataArray                                 |               | _required_ |

### predict_probabilistic { #wass2s.WAS_mme_FastBMA.predict_probabilistic }

```python
WAS_mme_FastBMA.predict_probabilistic(
    new_forecasts,
    *,
    clim_terciles=None,
    obs_for_terciles=None,
    tercile_q=(1 / 3, 2 / 3),
    quantiles=(0.1, 0.5, 0.9),
    member_dim='M',
    time_dim='T',
    lat_dim='Y',
    lon_dim='X',
)
```

Generate probabilistic forecasts from the fitted BMA mixture.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                                         | Description   | Default    |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------|---------------|------------|
| new_forecasts    | xr.DataArray                                 |               | _required_ |
| clim_terciles    | Optional\[xr.DataArray\]                     |               | `None`     |
| obs_for_terciles | dims(time_dim, lat_dim, lon_dim)\[optional\] |               | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|--------|-------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | xr.Dataset: | ``predictive_mean``       — (T, Y, X) ``predictive_quantiles``  — ('quantile', T, Y, X) ``tercile_probability``   — ('probability', T, Y, X)  [if terciles given] ``tercile_thresholds``    — ('tercile', Y, X)          [if terciles given] |
